profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at CrowdStrike
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a focus on multi-platform low-level systems development. Experience working on Windows and MacOS device drivers, with minor experience with Linux kernel development as well. Trained in Windows filesystem driver development by OSR. Comfortable using debuggers such as windbg and lldb to identify and fix problems in low-level systems. Languages of choice include Swift, C, C++, C#, and Java. Proficient with macOS performance debugging with tools like spindump, leaks, and fs_usage.
